__README: SAP /DMO/ Flight Reference Scenario oracle — Apache-2.0 (github.com/SAP-samples/abap-platform-refscen-flight). SOURCES: carrier_id/connection_id/airport_id are hardcoded in /DMO/CL_FLIGHT_DATA_GENERATOR VALUE #() literals (extracted 2026-06-14). Supplement price (2.30 EUR) is hardcoded in the same class ('Hot Chocolate', supplement_category=beverage). flight_price and IDs (travel_id/agency_id/customer_id/booking_id) are PLACEHOLDER — the ABAP generator assigns these dynamically; replace with a real export when available. total_price satisfies the kernel invariant: booking_fee + Σflight_price + Σsupplement_price = 527.30. SCOPE: witnesses document-lifecycle verbs ONLY (CREATE_DOCUMENT/CREATE_LINE/SET_STATUS) — the /DMO/ model has no FI tables, so POST/ALLOCATE/MATCH are NOT exercised here. Runner: scripts/poc_sap_flight.js.
